author: Paul Bennett
content:
Andy and his team were very professional and went above and beyond what I expected for my house clearance project.

Not only did they clear everything that we had agreed on but Andy took it upon himself to take out a huge home made desk and the shelving on three walls in the garage. He also helped me by repairing the garden fence as part of the package.

A true professional and can be recommended for any house clearance or removals.
